operations.why: Flatten the unframed Death Cause Message structure so the same two consecutive fields align with the Endstone packet layout. Both fields already exist in Mojang schemas.

evidence.summary: The referenced object contains the required attack-name string followed by the required string list.
The same two fields appear directly in the packet with matching encodings and order.
